persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a square poster: a little illustrated coffee cup in the bottom half, cream background, dark brown headline 'SLOW SUNDAY' centred near the top. Plenty of space around the headline. No other words.
bank.How much bigger: Approximately 150% of the original font size.
bank.Font, colour and placement: Keep the original font and dark brown colour, with the headline centred on its original centre point.
bank.Size and illustration style: Square, 640 by 640 pixels. Illustration style is your call.
bank.Other changes: None. Keep the coffee cup, background and all other artwork unchanged.

messages.text: I'd like you to make a poster with a cream background. I'm in a bit of a slow-weekend mood, which is why this idea appeals to me. The poster should be square, with the dark brown headline 'SLOW SUNDAY' centred near the top. There should be a little illustrated coffee cup in the bottom half. Please leave plenty of space around the headline, and don't include any other words. I always end up over-explaining these things because I worry I'll forget to mention something.
